s1.desc: an empty space with a plain pale grey background

beats.text: Pax stands with one flipper resting on his chest, looking ahead with wide eyes and his beak slightly open
Pax closes his eyes with a smug smile, then glances sideways with a smirk, his flipper still on his chest
Pax drops his flippers to his sides and glances around with a worried frown
Pax looks around with raised brows, his flippers hanging at his sides
Pax turns his body to the right and looks over that way
Pax turns back with a puzzled frown and angles his body toward the left
Pax blinks, then lifts both flippers out to his sides and stares ahead with wide eyes and an open beak
Pax hurries off to the left with quick steps and goes out of view

spans.notes: One continuous take on a fully plain ground (no texture at all: motion gives no fit; ground std < 0.3). Camera judged static by compare 0/72: Pax's feet and shadow overlap exactly while he stands, and his shadow line stays at y 0.69 throughout. He stands in place f0-73, then moves left from f74 (x 0.30-0.73 -> 0.00-0.09 at f96, last sliver f99), feet stepping. Top third and bottom fifth are the bare ground on every 8th frame: no caption or watermark. Pax leaves and comes back in the same take, so the return is a same_shot span | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v20): beat 1 (f0-20): f0-6 Pax looks ahead with wide round eyes and a slightly open beak (not sideways, not half-lidded); eyes close with a smug smile f8-9; he glances sideways with a smirk f10-19; beat 2 (f20-46): the worried frown holds f20-33 only; f34-45 his brows are raised and the frown is gone; beat 4 (f56-65): he faces forward only at f56, then angles his body toward the left f58-64 (3/4 view);
6 frames of empty plain ground between Pax's exit and his return

beats.text: Pax hurries in from the left with Polly slung belly-down over his shoulder and raises his free flipper with a grin
Pax grips Polly over his shoulder with both flippers and walks on to the right with an open-beaked grin
Pax carries Polly off to the right while she hangs limp over his shoulder with her eyes closed and her cheeks blushing

spans.notes: same plain-ground take: Pax re-enters at the left edge at f106 carrying Polly (her body from f110), crosses at a steady ~0.033 frame widths per frame with the shadow line fixed at y 0.69, and is gone by f153 (Polly's head last). Polly's eyes are closed with blushing cheeks while she is carried.
